caption: The drawing features a round, scalloped-edged plate with a decorative border. The plate is primarily tan in color with areas of green wash and brown shading, giving it an earthy, mottled appearance. The rim of the plate is outlined in a reddish-brown color. Around the inner border runs a band of stylized German script, drawn in dark brown. In the center of the plate is a symmetrical floral design, also rendered in shades of brown, green, and a touch of blue. The design consists of a central brown stem with pairs of curved, brown-outlined leaves and two large, stylized flowers with green-and-brown petals flanking the stem. At the bottom, the stem emerges from a circular pot or base, which is adorned with concentric circles and line patterns. The overall composition is contained within the bounds of the plate, and the plate is centered against a plain, light background.
title: Pennsylvania German Dish
